## Background
Hardworking and challenge-driven M.Tech (CSE – AI/ML) student at IIT Gandhinagar, specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Currently pursuing my thesis under the guidance of [Prof. Nipun Barta](https://nipunbatra.github.io/) and [Prof. Yogesh Meena](http://yogeshmeena.com/)., with a focus on speech recognition and automatic alt text generation to advance digital accessibility.

With over 2 years of experience as a JavaScript developer, I bring a strong foundation in hands-on development and research-driven problem-solving. Passionate about accessibility and inclusion, I continually push boundaries in NLP, computer vision, deep learning, HCI, and machine learning. I am deeply motivated to apply innovative strategies and dedicated effort to tackle real-world challenges and contribute meaningfully to impactful AI/ML research.

My motto is **"I can, will, and must."**

## Education
I completed my Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering at Rajasthan Technical University in Kota, Rajasthan from August 2014 to May 2018.
